description: This file defines a web search tool for X (formerly Twitter) using xAI, including configuration, caching, and execution logic.

classes.name: PluginToolInputError
classes.description: Custom error class for input validation errors in the plugin tool.

methods.name: getSharedXSearchCache
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes a shared cache for X search results.

methods.name: resolveXSearchConfig
methods.description: Resolves effective X search configuration based on provided config.

methods.name: resolveXSearchEnabled
methods.description: Determines if X search is enabled based on configuration and runtime settings.

methods.name: resolveXSearchApiKey
methods.description: Retrieves the API key for X search from configuration.

methods.name: normalizeOptionalIsoDate
methods.description: Validates and normalizes date strings in YYYY-MM-DD format.

methods.name: buildXSearchCacheKey
methods.description: Constructs a cache key string based on search parameters.

methods.name: createXSearchTool
methods.description: Creates and returns the X Search tool object with parameters and execution logic.
